status: One source-certified qamats restored and one false-positive yod-vowel note retired after contrasting same-page comparison and independent root review
method: Direct visual inspection of110 remaining point-note targets across chapters7–17 and19 in original PDF embedded image pixels. These targets are disjoint from WIS-source-note-review-20261017.json and WIS-note-reinspection-20261017-pass2.json.21 chapter19 targets were also inspected on2026-10-03; this pass is an additional look at those original pixels. Prior report bounds locate most crops but do not certify readings. Incorrect or overly broad locators were replaced by verified word crops. Nearest-neighbor enlargement only, with native-resolution proof for the accepted decisions; no OCR, sharpening, grammatical point supply or invented text. Point classification requires discriminating geometry and contrasting same-page exemplars. A tentative7:1 tsadi qamats proposal was withdrawn because fused tsadi sheva can yield a similar foot and stem. Authorized restored consonants and their source notes are excluded.
